texts.at_approver_amount: Tambayi mutum na biyu sama da wannan adadi
texts.at_approver_note: Har ila yau idan canji ya shafi kaya fiye da {items}. Mai roƙo ba ya taɓa tabbatar da roƙonsa.
texts.at_brief_note: Sai idan akwai abin faɗa, a lokacin da ka zaɓa, ba a cikin awannin shiru ba.
texts.at_brief_on: Aiko mini da taƙaitawa kowace safiya
texts.at_checked_twice: An haɗa sau biyu; duka sun yi daidai.
texts.at_hint_remember: Mai kawo mana kaya yana kawowa ranar Talata
texts.at_memory_empty: Babu abin da aka tuna tukuna.
texts.at_memory_note: Ana ajiye wa wannan kasuwanci kawai. Babu lambobin kati, PIN ko lambobin sirri. Ba a sayarwa ko rabawa.
texts.at_never_secrets: Ba a ajiye ba: yana kama da lambar kati ko lambar sirri.
texts.at_not_adviser: Ina bayani gaba ɗaya. Ni ba lauya ko akanta ko mai shawara ba ne; zan iya haɗa ka da ɗaya daga cikinsu.
texts.at_not_shown: Ba a nuna adadin ba saboda ba a iya lissafa shi daidai.
texts.at_part_hidden: An ɓoye wasu sassa saboda matsayinka.
texts.at_part_overdue: Takardun kuɗi da suka wuce lokaci: {n}
texts.at_pause_note: Idan an dakatar, LynkAssist tana amsawa amma ba ta canza komai.
texts.at_plan_note: Kowane mataki yana jiran tabbatarwarka. Za ka iya dakatar da shirin a kowane lokaci.
texts.at_practice_done: An yi a horo. Babu abin gaske da ya canza.
texts.at_practice_note: Yanayin horo: babu abin gaske da ke canzawa.
texts.at_q_due_soon: Me zai kai lokaci nan ba da jimawa ba?
texts.at_remember_off: Kunna ƙwaƙwalwa don ƙara wani abu.
texts.at_roles_note: Ba fiye da abin da matsayin kansa zai iya yi ba.
texts.at_roles_title: Abin da LynkAssist za ta iya yi wa kowane matsayi
texts.at_round_all: Kewaya duk farashi zuwa adadi mai kyau
texts.at_sample: Wannan yana canza kaya {n}. Ga {shown} daga cikinsu.
texts.at_save_daily: Ka tambaye ni wannan kowace rana
texts.at_saved: An adana. Za ka karɓi amsa kowace rana.
texts.at_second_approver: Wannan babban canji ne, don haka mutum na biyu zai tabbatar: {role}.
texts.at_sent_approver: An aika don mutum na biyu ya tabbatar.
texts.at_stopped_content_not_instructions: Wannan ya fito daga rubutun da LynkAssist ta karanta, don haka ba a yi shi ba.
texts.at_stopped_over_limit: Wannan ya wuce iyakar da mai kasuwanci ya sa.
texts.at_stopped_paused: An dakatar da ayyukan LynkAssist. Har yanzu tana amsawa, amma ba ta canza komai.
texts.at_stopped_register: Wannan yana buƙatar mutum ko ɗan bincike tukuna.
texts.at_stopped_role_off: Mai kasuwanci ya kashe wannan don matsayinka.
texts.at_sure_likely: Mai yiwuwa: wasu bayanai suna kan hanya
texts.at_unconfirmed: Wannan dokar ƙasa tana jiran tabbatarwa.
texts.at_usage_none: An yi amfani da {used}, tsarinka ba shi da iyaka
texts.at_w_cash_mismatch: Kuɗin da aka ƙirga bai yi daidai da abin da teburin kuɗi ke tsammani ba.
texts.at_w_duplicate_invoice: Wannan takardar kuɗi tana kama da kwafin wadda ka riga ka aika.
texts.at_w_payment_failing: Wannan biyan yana ci gaba da kasawa.
texts.at_w_price_below_cost: Wannan farashin ya yi ƙasa da abin da ya ci maka ({cost}).
texts.at_w_stock_low: Wannan kaya ya yi ƙasa da matakin sake oda.
